an5.294-302:1.1: Pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato nigaṇṭho . . . muṇḍasāvako . . . jaṭilako . . . paribbājako . . . māgaṇḍiko . . . tedaṇḍiko . . . aviruddhako . . . gotamako . . . devadhammiko yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
an5.294-302:1.3: Pāṇātipātī hoti, adinnādāyī hoti, abrahmacārī hoti, musāvādī hoti, surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhāyī hoti.
an5.294-302:1.4: Imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato devadhammiko yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye ti. 1.
